question:
Refer to the exhibit. What is the result of this configuration?
switch(config)# fcns proxy-port 21:00:00:b2:c5:71:32:a9 vsan 100
options: It adds an entry for the name server database.
It implements a mapping between the WWN and the VSAN.
It enables the registration of parameters for another node.
theory: The 'fcns proxy-port' command manually registers a proxy device, one that can't perform a normal FLOGI/PLOGI itself, into the Fibre Channel Name Server (FCNS) database for a given VSAN, adding an entry so other devices in the fabric can discover and resolve that WWN through the name server exactly as they would a normally logged-in device. This differs from the FLOGI database (which tracks physical logins per switch) and from a WWN-to-VSAN mapping mechanism, since it is specifically a name-server registration. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 8 - FLOGI and FCNS Databases)
